scientific_integrity: The reported closed forms are accompanied by a complete case analysis and reproducible bounded verification. Earlier general leaky-forcing theory and no-leak zero-forcing results are credited rather than claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Standard zero forcing with at most one forbidden forcer on two matched complete-graph layers of order at least three. Computational exhaustive checks cover only clique orders three through seven; the infinite theorem relies on the stated mathematical proof. Prior-literature completeness cannot be guaranteed.
title: All one-leak zero-forcing sets of complete prisms: a closed polynomial and minimal-set classification
